protocol.name: hyperdbdiag_ecsa_v2_main_comparison

scenario_generalization.reason: The registered leave-one-replicate-index-out protocol retains all 22 scenario identities in both training and evaluation partitions; it measures repeated-block diagnosis, not unseen-scenario transfer.

protocol.comparability: All evaluated methods use the same 660 cases, six outer folds, and root labels. OpDiag root detection uses frozen KPIs; DBAIOps derives its anomaly models and ExperienceGraph from the same training KPIs; EPDG-grounded rows additionally use integrity-bound anonymous SQL-shape evidence, while the complete HyperDBDiag row also includes constrained LLM arbitration.

canonical_protocol.name: hyperdbdiag_ecsa_v2
canonical_protocol.evaluation: six fixed replicate folds; 550 training and 110 evaluation cases per fold
canonical_protocol.calibration: five training-only inner groups; refitted models; unchanged frozen selection rule
canonical_protocol.arbitration: all evaluation cases; no test-call budget or selected-case gate
canonical_protocol.pool_effect_supplement: both arms use upstream top-1 fallback; kept separate from complete method
canonical_protocol.llm_execution: exact frozen primary-input replay including original failures; no repeat substitution
limitations: same development dataset and known scenarios; not a new independent test set
changes from historical main include local policy, arbitration coverage and prompt/transport
replay duration is not end-to-end inference latency

protocol.baseline_policy: reuse unchanged registered held-out predictions; recompute all summaries
protocol.inference_policy: calibrated conservative local readout, full-coverage pool arbitration, local fallback
